acceptance: At admission_stage enforce, a lane admitted only by the shared-edit rule carries its would-be holder to the ship (red test first)
A composed-gate failure or rebase conflict of such a lane publishes one signal with todo, holder and gate
The rate is readable for one wave (evolve wave status or the wave record)
fix: TDD first (red test before code), 100% coverage on new and changed functions, zero comments, the package note and the spec updated; do not change the composed-tree gate itself.
source: W1 PR review (architecture-reviewer finding 1), plan wave-latency-2026-10 W1b
summary: W1 built the admission half of plan wave-latency-2026-10 D2: fleet.orchestrator.admission_stage (default shadow) and LOOP_ORCH_ADMISSION_REACH_SHADOW. At shadow a freed candidate never runs beside its holder, so the D3 failure rate cannot be measured there. W1b: mark each lane that only the shared-edit rule admitted (at admission_stage enforce), and at its ship record each rebase conflict or composed-tree gate failure against the lane that the reach rule would have held it behind. W2 (the move to enforce) waits for W1b; above one in five failures in the first enforce wave the stage goes back to shadow.
title: Wave latency W1b: the ship records a composed-gate failure between two lanes that only the shared-edit rule admitted (ADR-0143 D2)
